ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized to specific markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-gray to black pigmentation across approximately 95% of visible surface. One distinct high-contrast white linear mark located in the mid-section of the left lobe. Sparse white punctate clusters on the distal tips and along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute internal angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged, irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. A prominent, large rectangular-shaped notch/void is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately two-thirds of the distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves along the leading edges, tapering to sharp upward-oriented points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, roughly circular high-contrast white spots concentrated on both lobe tips and along the lower trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, sharply defined white linear abrasion is present on the ventral surface of the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the center toward the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Macroscopic traumatic notch or amputation on the right lobe trailing edge; prominent linear white scar on the left lobe.
